messages:
alice_sales: Heads-up 8: Keun (fintech) POC starting next Mon. They sent two variants: keun-lite-int8 and keun-pro-qat. Requirement: Dedicated with Hosted failover, 60 qps steady, p95 <180ms for lite, <650ms for pro. Also asked about SOC2, KMS, and a committed pricing estimate. @rachel_se @javier_ml @oscar_ops please advise.

rachel_se: Thanks. Do we have max sequence length and tokenizer details? Any custom ops in the QAT variant?

alice_sales: Seq max = 2048, tokenizer = HF BPE with a 2k token custom vocab, no custom CUDA ops declared but QAT model notes "fused attention kernels". They emphasized deterministic output for compliance.

javier_ml: Determinism + QAT + fused kernels = possible mismatch with our optimized kernels. We should ask for a plain PyTorch checkpoint and a minimal loader that uses standard nn.Layer/attn calls. Also request a small labeled eval set for regression.

oscar_ops: For infra: 60 qps batched suggests 2x optimized nodes for lite and 3x for pro if multi-card needed. We can do Dedicated BYO-KMS. Hosted fallback requires enterprise onboarding and key escrow discussions. I'll sketch cost sim after we confirm batch sizes and sequence mix.

alice_sales: Can someone give a rapid ballpark before cost sim so I can quote?

oscar_ops: Rough numbers: lite ~ $12k/mo (1x optimized reserved), pro ~ $36k/mo (multi-card reserve). These are placeholders pending perf runs.

javier_ml: On the tech plan: 1) compatibility scan (load + forward) 2) perf profiling (batch/kv/cache) 3) quant/latency tuning 4) canary on Dedicated + fallback to Hosted. Need owners: @javier_ml (scan + quant), @oscar_ops (infra + cost sim), @priya_sec (SQ responses).

priya_sec: I'll draft security answers. Key points to cover: data-in-transit encryption, retention policies, KMS BYO support, audit log exports, SOC2 controls. Anything specific Keun asked?

alice_sales: They want logs pushed to their SIEM, key separation, and a 3-week KMS onboarding window. Also a question about whether we persist prompts.

priya_sec: Draft reply: we do not persist customer prompts beyond configured retention windows by default; ephemeral KV cache is not written to durable storage unless explicitly configured; audit logs can be exported to customer SIEM via our logs exporter; BYO KMS (Dedicated/Private) supported, Hosted requires enterprise onboarding. I'll include SOC2 page link and timeline for KMS (2-3 weeks).

javier_ml: Also request two artifacts: (1) loader script example they run locally (one-liner) and (2) a tiny synthetic checkpoint (100MB) to validate load. Suggest they include this CLI snippet to generate loader test:

```bash
python tools/mini_loader.py --checkpoint s3://KEUN/release/small.ckpt --tokenizer s3://KEUN/tokens --input-shape 1,2048
```

alice_sales: I'll ask Keun to provide both.

rachel_se: For evals: prefer a 200-example labeled suite that checks determinism and key compliance phrases. We'll run our regen/sample and a deterministic seed test.

oscar_ops: Note: maintenance window Wed 03:30-04:30 UTC might overlap with canary tests. Also for Dedicated we can pin region for data residency.

ci_bot: CI reminder: model-compat-scan job queued. ETA ~48h after artifacts available.

alice_sales: Timeline proposed to Keun: send artifacts today, we'll run compatibility scan Tue-Wed, perf/quant Thu, canary Dedicated Fri (if scans pass). KMS onboarding timeframe 2-3 weeks for production. Is that agreeable?

javier_ml: Ack. Will prioritize scan and push any adapter work to next sprint if their fused ops require a shim.

priya_sec: I'll attach the SQ answers when ready and include SOC2 and penetration test summary pointers.

alice_sales: Great. I'll follow up with Keun and post S3 links + eval set here. :thumbsup:
